purpose: Independent replication of the evaluation-unit claim on unused same-day material.

selection_rules.R2: window must be covered by all four cameras continuously
selection_rules.R3: any overlap with the 12 existing train/val/test segments excludes the window (0 s tolerance)
selection_rules.R4: inter-volume gaps <= 60 s count as continuous; > 60 s breaks the window; an overlap counts as continuous too (the 320 seam overlaps by 4 s)
selection_rules.R5: gallery window is fixed at 60 min, matching the main experiment
selection_rules.R6: query window is fixed at 15 min and must start >= 60 min after the gallery ends
selection_rules.R7: candidates ranked by number of volume seams, then by start time; first one wins

known_asymmetries: gallery-to-query gap is 71 min, versus more than 4 h in the main experiment; appearance changes less, so the holdout is an easier setting
the gallery crosses a volume boundary on 305 and on 320; the 320 seam is a 4 s overlap (543 starts at 11:26:12, before 540 ends at 11:26:16), skipped by starting the second slice at offset 4 s

volumes 529 and 517 on camera 305 meet at 11:24:52 with no gap and no overlap (the last frame of 529 and the first frame of 517 carry the same OSD timestamp); the second slice therefore starts at offset 0 s

extra.318_test_534b: expansion segment from 14:22, 107 tracks / 80 unlabelled / 0 truth; already used in a CI diagnostic, therefore contaminated

pipeline.detector: YOLO26s-seg via tools/yolo_track_det.py (first version; sha256 54f052d30a50bbc8afc7e5580cbabed2a352cbd91feb7d2910bf4e377b633fad), weights yolo26s-seg.pt (sha256 3da1d83e31caec96f9300eb4064f4f62882c133c7c264d63dfe61a7c197837a4), imgsz 1280, conf 0.10, NMS iou 0.7 (pass --iou 0.7 explicitly; the script default changed to 0.5), classes=[0]

tracker.name: Ultralytics built-in ByteTrack via model.track(persist=True) with tools/bytetrack_1012.yaml
tracker.buffer_semantics: counted in processed frames: about 24 s real time in gallery segments (stride 10) and 12 s in query segments (stride 5); kept as in the main experiment, not corrected
tracker.superseded: an earlier draft froze GatedByteTrack defaults from tools/yolo_track_det_v2.py (high 0.35 / low 0.10 / new 0.45 / match 0.80 / buffer 2.0 s) and NMS 0.5; withdrawn on 2026-10-24 because it is not the production implementation

pipeline.encoder: OSNet osnet_x1_0_msmt17_combineall_256x128_amsgrad_ep150_stp60_lr0.0015_b64_fb10_softmax_labelsmooth_flip_jitter.pth (sha256 48df972f72887b95cf3b43b3a07c3a7d2398381aea0f9cae64a7ef11d512b727), one embedding per half, BGR channel order
pipeline.clustering: camera-aware: within-camera average 0.15, cross-camera complete 0.25, no same-camera merge
pipeline.selection: self-cal: same >= 0.90 and evaluable >= 100, maximise coverage
pipeline.slicing_note: the 4 s overlap at the 320 seam (11:26:12-11:26:16) is skipped by starting the second slice at offset 4 s: no frame interpolation, no cross-volume stitching

sampling.evidence: frame indices in the stored detections: train segments step 10, test segments step 5 at 25 fps

same_frame_dedup.stage: after tracking, before half-split and encoding
same_frame_dedup.method: per-frame greedy NMS: rank boxes by detection confidence descending, drop a candidate if its IoU with any already-kept box is >= 0.5
same_frame_dedup.drop_semantics: a dropped box is simply absent in that frame; its track continues in later frames
same_frame_dedup.not_used: mask-containment >= 0.9 (--dedup-mask); default off and rejected in an earlier ablation

confirmed_from_artifacts: detection/tracking script and ByteTrack config (tools/yolo_track_det.py, tools/bytetrack_1012.yaml; hashes match the 2026-10-24 export MANIFEST)
sampling strides (tools/run_yolo_u1.sh lines 4-5; stored frame indices)
provenance.decision: 2026-10-24: project owner chose production values for all pipeline parameters
provenance.pre_run_check: verify local sha256 of tools/yolo_track_det.py, tools/bytetrack_1012.yaml, tools/dedup_detections.py against the values above; any mismatch is a deviation under section 6

conventions.answerable: evaluable AND not non-person AND identity present in gallery
conventions.paired_test: exact McNemar, two-sided, over all answerable queries

hypotheses.claim: inherited precision negatively rank-correlated with C

not_replicated_reason: mechanistic, not primary; holdout size insufficient for stable cluster-level AUC

infeasible_guard.note: report descriptive numbers regardless of the verdict

expected_scale.note: lunch-time trough; may fall below the 100 guard; declared in advance, not a criterion

no_window_switching: only 10:46-11:46 / 12:57-13:12 are valid; if the material turns out damaged, record it as a deviation, do not silently pick another window

requires: two author signatures (left blank on 2026-10-24 by decision; recorded on the signature sheet)
freeze.note: frozen 2026-10-24 with the signature lines intentionally left blank. The signature sheet is kept outside the hashed set: putting the signatures inside this document would change its hash on signing and invalidate the manifest. Load-bearing files and scripts are not edited after freezing; signing is a ratification of the same text.
freeze.hashed_set_note: load-bearing set = the two preregistration files and six scripts listed in files; the signature sheet is excluded so that signing does not change any hash
freeze.external_timestamp: before the run, send the manifest to a place whose timestamp the authors cannot alter (e-mail to co-authors, a pushed remote commit, or an OSF registration) and record the location on the signature sheet
freeze.refrozen: 2026-10-24: second freeze after renaming segments, recording both smoke runs, and adding the annotation protocol and analysis scripts; no data-dependent change

known_limitations: personnel may overlap between the holdout window and the segments already used
single day, single site, four uncalibrated cameras
gallery-to-query gap is 71 min versus more than 4 h in the main experiment, so the holdout is easier
the query window sits in the lunch-time trough, so answerable queries may fall below 100
the gallery crosses one volume boundary on 305 and one on 320; the 320 seam carries a 4 s overlap which the slice skips, so the 320 gallery covers 3559 s rather than 3600 s
H2a and H2b are not replicated
track_buffer = 60 processed frames: about 24 s in gallery segments (stride 10) and 12 s in query segments (stride 5); kept as in the main experiment

pre_run_observations.what: smoke run on the 323 query piece (then named H_qry_323, now 323_hqry): 400 sampled frames = 2000 source frames = 80 s from 12:57
pre_run_observations.result: 0 boxes detected, 0 tracks after the a/b split
pre_run_observations.corroboration: density probes: 320 at 12:58 and 13:14 = 0 persons, 323 at 13:03 = 0 persons
pre_run_observations.rationale: changing the window after seeing an unfavourable signal would be a data-dependent design change; the infeasible guard (answerable < 100 -> UNDECIDABLE) covers this case
pre_run_observations.reporting: descriptive numbers are reported regardless of the verdict

pre_run_observations.what: smoke run on the first 305 gallery piece (then named H_gal_305_p1, now 305_hgal_p1): 400 sampled frames = 4000 source frames = 160 s from 10:46
pre_run_observations.result: about 286 / 297 tracks after the a/b split; encoded (512-d)
pre_run_observations.rationale: used only to confirm the command chain runs and to estimate run time; no clustering, no annotation, no identity or correctness information was produced

pre_run_observations.what: seam audit before the run, read off the OSD timestamp burned into the video (no detection, no annotation): first and last frame of all 10 pieces decoded
pre_run_observations.result: 305: last frame of 529 and first frame of 517 both read 11:24:52 and their OSD pixels are identical, so the previous offset of 13 s dropped a 13 s stretch; 320: 540 ends at 11:26:16 while 543 starts at 11:26:12, i.e. a 4 s overlap, not the 41 s hole recorded earlier
pre_run_observations.rationale: a parameter error can be fixed before the run without touching any identity or correctness information; the same change after unblinding would have to be reported as a deviation

segment_names.rule: segment names must start with the camera id; downstream code (d7_sweep.py line 67 and others) takes the camera as seg.split('_')[0], and camera-aware clustering depends on it
segment_names.renamed_from: H_gal_* / H_qry_* (first freeze); the old names would have parsed all four cameras as 'H'

smoke_outputs.policy: not reused; the formal run writes to output_crosscam_local/holdout/ from scratch

annotation_protocol.gallery_scope: all members of clusters that received at least one accepted query in A_baseline or C_dmax0.30 (union); reproduces the 257 labelled gallery tracks of the main experiment exactly
annotation_protocol.blinding: templates carry only track id, segment and camera; no cluster id, score or acceptance; rows shuffled with seed 20261024
annotation_protocol.labels: main-experiment roster codes; new people get new codes; retired codes (e.g. female4) are not reused; no-human for shadows/reflections/objects; shadow* for unresolvable far-field figures; UNK for unclear

analysis.sweep: d7_sweep.py --min-eval 100 --same-min 0.90 (primary); --robust-margin 0.10 as a supplementary table only
analysis.h1b_tie_break: if several configurations share the highest inherited precision, take the lexicographically smallest name and list the others
analysis.validation: on the main-experiment data the evaluator reproduces C 117 / W 4 / U 2, precision 0.9669, C/N 0.5109, rho -0.418, H1b -61, H1c 0.585, H2c -27 (p = 1.1e-7), H3 73 vs 4, and 22 Bonferroni-significant configurations, all negative
